host.power: AC power, 100% charge before and after
host.conditions: Other workstation applications remained active, including IDEs, WindowServer and a virtual machine. No competing Neri build or sanitizer process during timings. No affinity, frequency control or per-sample load telemetry.

method.order: Four cyclic configuration orders, each occupying every position once; worker order reversed on odd repetitions. Processes below retain exact execution order.
method.validation: All 208 process exits are zero. All 1456 sample checksums match independent recurrence or closed-form oracles. All C# processes report the pinned runtime identity and workstation GC.
method.sampleEncoding: Each milliseconds array retains samples 0..6 in order. All seven checksums in each process equal its checksum field.
method.statistic: Median of four process medians; process metrics include setup, warmup and reporting, while kernel milliseconds do not.

limitations: The workload builds and traverses task-local linked lists and returns scalar checksums; it does not measure managed-result adoption, general mutable-input transfer or memory bandwidth saturation.
Neri includes final child-heap cleanup and worker startup/join. .NET chooses its own collection policy and may reuse thread-pool workers. No forced collection normalizes their costs.
The .NET references use workstation GC, not server GC. These results do not establish the best .NET configuration for parallel allocation.
Neri's sequential allocation-batch is slower than all three sequential .NET references. Its scaling is relative to its own sequential time, not an absolute per-core throughput claim.
One Neri p14 process has a 43 ms median versus 27–28 ms in the others. All samples remain included; no cause is inferred from the available telemetry.
A heterogeneous workstation with background applications does not establish processor optimality or predict native x86-64 performance.

references.title: Hierarchical Memory Management for Parallel Programs (2016)
references.relevance: Independent task heaps motivate concurrent collection. Neri's nonmoving collector and ownership adoption are distinct from the paper's copying mechanism and formal calculus.

references.title: Microsoft: workstation and server garbage collection
references.relevance: GC mode changes the execution and memory configuration of parallel allocation workloads.
